tei:div.tei:p: )༄༅// stag sham lugs kyi bkra shis phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//

rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// mnyam med bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyobs pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /gang gi byin rlabs 'od zer rab 'phros pas// bdag sogs rmongs pa ma lus thams cad kyi// snying gi mun pa ma lus sel mdzad pa'i// bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bkra shis shog /thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyed kyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyobs// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang*// shākya thub pa gau'u tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi bkra shis shog /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyi bkra shis shog /mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing*// spyod pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong gi bkra shis shog /chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung mtsho rgyal sa le 'od// rgyal sras lha rje rig 'dzin yab sras gnyis// don brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī seng*// pad+ma kā ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga// so zur gnubs gnyags gter ston brgya rtsa sogs// bka' gter bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rgya che rab zab chos dbyings rgya mtsho las// rin chen mchog brnyes bde gshegs pad+mo'i zhal// gsung mchog rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtso// rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi bkra shis shog

/rgyal tshab dam pa rgya mtsho las 'khrungs shing*// skye 'chi gnyis spangs tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes// dregs pa tshar gcod srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// mnyam nyid o rgyan rje yi bkra shis shog /ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje// pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum rdo rje 'chang gi bkra shis shog /mnga' bdag nyang ral chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// 'khrul med gling pa bcu gcig dri med gsum// rgod kyi ldem 'phru pad+ma dbang rgyal sogs// gter brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ār+ya sa le'i yang srid spar stod 'khrungs// dga' tshal yi dam dgongs 'dus chos rten sogs// thugs gter bcu gnyis mnga' bdag stag sham pa// o rgyan bsam gtan gling pa'i bkra shis shog /phyogs dus rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung*// 'khor lo'i mgon po stag sham chos rje gling*// byin rlabs thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i mgon// pad+ma bde byed rol pa'i bkra shis shog /dag mnyam gzhi yi gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin// zung 'jug 'bras bu mngon gyur tshe la dbang*// mchog tu grub pa'i zhabs kyi bkra shis shog sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos sku mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs kyi bkra shis shog /mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni// dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs// thugs rje bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston// rdo rje sems dpa' che yi bkra shis shog /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs kyi bkra shis shog

/'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog /phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*// spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i// btsun pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi bkra shis shog /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa'i sku// zhi khro sku gsum lha yi bkra shis shog /che mchog yang dag 'jam dpal rta mgrin dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /bla ma rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung mchog pad+ma'i gsung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas rngams chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad kyi bkra shis shog /bskal pa'i me 'bar rlung nag 'khrugs pa'i klong*// bde gshegs kun 'dus hūm̐ nag rol pa rtsal// thugs mchog gsang bdag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// 'jigs byed khro rgyal dpal gyi bkra shis shog /zhi khro yi dam 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can// dngos grub rtsa ba thugs rje spyan ras gzigs// rta mgrin dbang chen 'khor 'das spyi dpal gtso// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos sku spros bral dbyings yum kun bzang mo// longs spyod rdzogs mdzad rdo rje phag mo ste// gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku mchog mkha' 'gro'i gtso// ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs kyi bkra shis shog

/ma mo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo ste// bar ched sel mdzad rdo rje phag mo yum// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi// ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /stong nyid snying rje'i ngang las thugs rje'i sku// rgyal ba bskyed yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud 'dul seng gdong ma yi bkra shis shog /chos sku bde chen dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// bstan pa srung phyir drag po'i tshul bstan pa// bstan la gdug pa ma lus tshar gcod pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /chos sku skye med che mchog he ru ka /longs sku 'gag med ma ning khro bo'i rgyal// sprul sku rnal 'byor bstan srung mnga' bdag tshogs// dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i bkra shis shog /sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la// ma yi bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras// nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam+bha la// dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma// nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nor lha gter skyong chu dbang 'khor bcas rnams// rin chen ri rab nyi zla lta bu'i sku// dngos grub mi zad thams cad ster ba'i lha// gter bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /zab cing rgya che'i gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing*// dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog

/chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs dug lnga gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /dpal ldan bla mas deng 'dir stsol// yi dam lha yis deng 'dir stsol// chos skyong srung mas deng 'dir stsol// gzhi bdag rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol// mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral 'khrul med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang 'bral ba dang*// mthun pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan grags nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'bad dang rtsol ba ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur tam// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis// shin tu bden par gsungs shing rdzun med pa// bden pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'tshogs// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// bshad sgrub thos bsam rgyun mi 'chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /lha rnams mkha' las me tog char chen 'bebs// klu rnams kun gyis sa gzhi 'byor pas bkang*// bar du skye rgu thams cad bde skyid ldan// mthar thug mngon sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'dir yang bkra shis shing*// nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la// mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li// nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog /bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs la khyab// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam gcig pu ru// rgyal bas yongs bsngags theg mchog rdzogs pa che// rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs snga 'gyur ba'i// rgyal bstan phyogs mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su 'byon pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yi// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog

/gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /de ltar du 'grub par byed pa'ang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/// /
